name: ITIL 4 and IT Service Management
certifications: ITIL 4 Managing Professional (CDS, DSV, HVIT, DPI)

beginner.summary: For IT staff, service desk analysts and team leads new to IT service management. Covers ITIL 4 key concepts, the four dimensions, the service value system, guiding principles, the service value chain and the most used practices, with hands-on work in a service management tool, ending with a service desk simulation and Foundation exam preparation.
prerequisites: Works in or with an IT team
Basic understanding of IT services such as email, networks and applications
Access to Jira Service Management or a ServiceNow developer instance
outcomes: Explain ITIL 4 concepts, the service value system and guiding principles
Handle incidents, requests, problems and changes in a service tool
Describe the main ITIL practices and how they create value
Prepare for the ITIL 4 Foundation exam

days.topic: IT Service Management and ITIL 4 Overview
subtopics: History of ITIL and what changed in ITIL 4
ITIL and other frameworks: DevOps, Agile, Lean
days.lab_task: Describe three IT services at a case company in terms of value, outcomes, costs, risks, utility and warranty, and set up the service project in the tool.
days.deliverable: Service descriptions and configured service project

days.topic: The Four Dimensions of Service Management
subtopics: Applying the dimensions to a service
days.lab_task: Analyse a failed service launch using the four dimensions and PESTLE, list gaps in each dimension and propose fixes.
days.deliverable: Four-dimension analysis and fixes
checks: Gaps found in all four dimensions
At least one external factor per letter considered

days.topic: The Service Value System and Guiding Principles
days.lab_task: Map a case organisation's service value system and apply the seven guiding principles to five decisions it made, recommending better choices.
days.deliverable: SVS map and decision analysis
checks: Each linked to at least one principle

days.topic: The Service Value Chain and Value Streams
days.lab_task: Map two value streams (a new laptop request and a major incident) through the value chain activities and identify where each practice contributes.
days.deliverable: Two value stream maps
checks: Every step linked to a value chain activity
Find a delay in one stream

days.lab_task: Set up a self-service portal with request types, handle 15 simulated contacts through different channels and measure first contact resolution.
days.deliverable: Portal configuration, handled tickets and metrics
checks: Raise a request from the portal
Ticket created in the right queue
Handle an upset caller in a role play
Issue logged and the caller reassured

days.lab_task: Handle 20 simulated incidents including one major incident: prioritise them with a matrix, escalate, communicate, resolve and close, then report metrics.
days.deliverable: Incident records, major incident report and metrics
checks: Updates sent at the agreed intervals
Mean time to resolve and SLA breaches shown

days.lab_task: Build three request types with forms and approval workflows (new laptop, software access, password reset), automate one and measure fulfilment time.
days.deliverable: Configured request types and metrics

days.lab_task: Find a problem from a pattern of 30 incidents, run a root cause analysis with five whys and a fishbone, record a known error with a workaround and plan the permanent fix.
days.deliverable: Problem record, root cause analysis and known error

days.lab_task: Raise one standard, one normal and one emergency change, assess risk, get approval from the right change authority and run a post-implementation review.
days.deliverable: Change records and review notes

days.lab_task: Write an SLA for the email service with targets, configure SLA timers in the tool, run a month of simulated tickets and hold a service review with the customer.
days.deliverable: SLA document, timer configuration and service review report
checks: Timers start and pause as designed
Customer view captured beyond the numbers

subtopics: Integrating monitoring with the service tool
days.lab_task: Classify 30 sample events, set thresholds for a web service, connect an alert to automatic incident creation and reduce noise by correlating related alerts.
days.deliverable: Event classification, thresholds and integration evidence

days.topic: Information Security Management and Access Requests
days.lab_task: Process access requests with approvals and least privilege, handle a phishing report as a security incident and add a security check to the change process.
days.deliverable: Access request records, security incident and updated change workflow
checks: Approved by the data owner with least privilege
Routed to security with the right priority
Run a change with the security check

days.topic: IT Asset and Service Configuration Management
subtopics: IT assets and their life cycle
Using the CMDB for incidents and changes
tools: Jira Service Management Assets or ServiceNow CMDB
days.lab_task: Model a web service in the CMDB with servers, databases and applications and their relationships, use it to find the impact of a planned change and check licence compliance.
days.deliverable: CMDB model, impact analysis and licence report
checks: Link an incident to a CI

subtopics: Deployment approaches: big bang, phased, canary
days.lab_task: Plan a phased release of a new HR app with a deployment approach, rollback plan, communication and early life support.
days.deliverable: Release plan and communication

days.lab_task: Write five knowledge articles from resolved tickets, link them to the portal, and measure how often users find answers without raising a ticket.
days.deliverable: Articles and usage measures
checks: Follow the template and are easy to follow
Search the portal for a common issue
Percentage of searches without a ticket

days.lab_task: Use the continual improvement model to improve first contact resolution: set a vision, baseline, target and actions, record it in the register and review simulated results.
days.deliverable: Improvement register entry and review

days.lab_task: Map the case company's key relationships and suppliers, set measures for one supplier, run a performance review and handle a dispute over an SLA breach.
days.deliverable: Relationship map, supplier scorecard and review notes
checks: Resolved with reference to the contract

subtopics: Metrics, KPIs and critical success factors
days.lab_task: Build a service management dashboard with incident, request, change and satisfaction measures and write a one-page monthly report for leaders.
days.deliverable: Dashboard and monthly report
checks: Each measure linked to a goal
Fits one page with trends and actions

days.lab_task: Take a 40-question timed practice exam, review every wrong answer against the syllabus and write a final study plan.
days.deliverable: Practice score, review notes and study plan
checks: Each linked to a syllabus area

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Running a Service Desk for a Week
subtopics: Incidents, requests and a major incident
days.lab_task: Run a simulated week of service management: handle incidents and requests, manage a major incident, raise a problem and a change, write knowledge articles and present a weekly service report.
days.deliverable: Tool records, major incident report, weekly report and a 10-minute presentation
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one week of service

intermediate.summary: For service management practitioners and team leads. Covers the ITIL 4 practices in depth (service desk, incident, problem, change, service level, monitoring, request, asset and configuration, release, deployment), designing workflows in ServiceNow or Jira Service Management, availability, capacity and continuity, service financial management, and ITIL 4 Create, Deliver and Support and Drive Stakeholder Value content.
prerequisites: Holds ITIL 4 Foundation or equivalent knowledge
Works in a service management role
Has used a service management tool
outcomes: Design and run ITIL practices with workflows and measures
Configure service tools to support practices
Manage availability, capacity, continuity and service costs
Design customer journeys and value streams for services

days.lab_task: Design the value stream for onboarding a new employee's IT, find waste, choose practices for each step and automate two steps in the tool.
days.deliverable: Value stream design and automation evidence

subtopics: Automation and AI in incident handling
days.lab_task: Design a major incident procedure with roles, communication templates and a status page, run a swarming exercise and hold a blameless review.
days.deliverable: Procedure, communications and review report
checks: Roles followed and updates on time

days.lab_task: Analyse six months of incident data to find the top three problems, run Kepner-Tregoe analysis on one, raise the fixing change and estimate incidents avoided.
days.deliverable: Trend analysis, problem records and value estimate

days.lab_task: Redesign the change process so low-risk changes are approved automatically from the pipeline, normal changes use peer review and only high-risk changes go to a board.
days.deliverable: Change models, automation and process document

subtopics: SLAs for cloud and SaaS services
days.lab_task: Redesign SLAs for three services with experience measures and surveys, build a service report and create a service improvement plan for one breaching service.
days.deliverable: SLAs, service report and improvement plan

days.lab_task: Redesign the service catalogue around user needs, add a virtual agent for top requests, automate three fulfilment flows and measure self-service adoption.
days.deliverable: Catalogue design, virtual agent and adoption metrics
checks: Ask the virtual agent for a password reset
All three complete end to end

subtopics: Purpose of service validation and testing
Linking testing to change and release
days.lab_task: Write service acceptance criteria and a test plan for a new remote access service, run user and operational acceptance tests and decide whether it can go live.
days.deliverable: Acceptance criteria, test plan, results and go-live decision
checks: Cover function, performance, support and security
Support team confirms runbooks and monitoring are ready
Based on the criteria and results

subtopics: Managing on-premise, cloud and hybrid infrastructure
days.lab_task: Build a monthly patching process with standard changes, maintenance windows and reporting for 200 servers, and define the platform services offered to product teams.
days.deliverable: Patching process, change templates and platform service catalogue
checks: Pre-approved and scheduled in a window
Each service has an owner and request path

days.topic: Configuring ServiceNow or Jira Service Management for ITIL Practices
days.lab_task: Configure incident, request and change workflows with assignment rules, SLAs, notifications and approvals in the tool, and test each path.
days.deliverable: Configured workflows and test results
checks: Right people notified at each step

subtopics: Mean time between failures and to restore
days.lab_task: Calculate availability for three services from incident data, find single points of failure and plan improvements to meet a 99.9 percent target.
days.deliverable: Availability report and improvement plan
checks: Each named with the service affected

days.lab_task: Forecast capacity for a growing service from 12 months of usage, plan cloud capacity with autoscaling and estimate cost for two options.
days.deliverable: Capacity forecast, plan and cost comparison

days.lab_task: Run a business impact analysis for five services, set recovery objectives, write a disaster recovery plan for one and run a tabletop test.
days.deliverable: Business impact analysis, DR plan and test report

days.lab_task: Build a cost model for the email service, calculate cost per user, design a showback report for business units and compare cloud and on-premise costs.
days.deliverable: Cost model, showback report and comparison

days.topic: Deployment Management and Working with DevOps
subtopics: Integrating the pipeline with the service tool
days.lab_task: Connect a deployment pipeline to the service tool so each deployment creates a change record and release notes, and run a rollback with the record updated.
days.deliverable: Integration configuration and records
checks: Change record updated with the outcome

days.topic: Customer Journeys and Experience (Drive Stakeholder Value)
days.lab_task: Map the customer journey for a new employee using IT services, find pain points, redesign the onboarding experience and define experience measures.
days.deliverable: Journey map, redesign and measures

days.lab_task: Design the value stream and team set-up to create and support a new collaboration service, prioritise the work and plan shift-left support.
days.deliverable: Value stream design, team plan and support model
checks: Practices and teams placed at each step

subtopics: ITSM for HR, facilities and finance
days.lab_task: Extend the service portal to HR and facilities with request types, workflows and knowledge, and measure adoption after a simulated month.
days.deliverable: Configured HR and facilities services and adoption report
checks: Routed to HR with the right workflow

days.topic: AI and Automation in Service Management
subtopics: AI for ticket classification and routing
tools: ServiceNow Now Assist or Jira Service Management AI
days.lab_task: Turn on AI ticket classification and knowledge suggestions, compare routing accuracy with manual routing on 100 tickets and write rules for safe AI use.
days.deliverable: Accuracy comparison and AI rules
checks: Accuracy for AI and manual recorded

days.topic: ITIL Practitioner Exam Preparation: CDS and DSV
days.lab_task: Take timed practice exams for Create, Deliver and Support and Drive Stakeholder Value, review wrong answers and plan study.
days.deliverable: Practice scores, review notes and study plan
checks: Each linked to a syllabus area
objectives: Prepare for ITIL Managing Professional modules

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Service Management Redesign for a Business Unit
days.lab_task: Assess a business unit's service management, redesign value streams and practices, configure workflows and automation, plan availability and continuity, and present a measured improvement plan.
days.deliverable: Assessment, designs, tool configuration and a 15-minute presentation
checks: Strengths and gaps backed by data
Incident, request and change paths work
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one redesign

advanced.summary: For IT service managers, heads of service and ITSM leaders. Covers ITIL 4 High-velocity IT, Direct Plan and Improve, Digital and IT Strategy, service strategy and portfolio management, governance, risk and compliance, SIAM for multi-vendor environments, ITSM with SRE and DevOps, AIOps, organisational change and leading service transformation.
prerequisites: Has led a service management team or practice
Holds ITIL 4 Foundation and preferably a practitioner module
outcomes: Set IT and service strategy aligned to the business
Govern services, risk and suppliers including SIAM
Lead high-velocity, SRE and AIOps ways of working

days.lab_task: Develop a digital and IT strategy for a case company with its market position, digital opportunities, strategic approach and measures, and present it to a mock board.
days.deliverable: Strategy document and board presentation

days.lab_task: Review a portfolio of 40 IT services, rationalise it by value and cost, build a business case for a new service and run a portfolio review.
days.deliverable: Portfolio analysis, business case and review record
checks: Each kept, merged or retired with a reason

days.lab_task: Run a self-assessment of a service organisation, set direction and improvement goals, plan the change and define the reporting that will track it.
days.deliverable: Self-assessment, improvement plan and reporting design

days.topic: Governance, Risk and Compliance in IT Services
subtopics: IT governance frameworks: COBIT and ITIL
days.lab_task: Map service management controls to ISO 20000 and ISO 27001 requirements, find gaps, plan remediation and prepare an audit evidence pack.
days.deliverable: Control mapping, gap list, remediation plan and evidence pack
checks: Each requirement mapped to a control
Each gap has an owner and date

days.lab_task: Design a SIAM model for a company with five service providers, define cross-provider incident and change processes and set end-to-end measures.
days.deliverable: SIAM design, processes and measures

subtopics: Ways of working: Agile, Lean, DevOps, SRE
days.lab_task: Assess an IT team's delivery against high-velocity behaviours and DORA metrics, choose improvements and plan how ITSM practices will support faster delivery.
days.deliverable: Assessment, DORA metrics and improvement plan

days.lab_task: Define SLIs, SLOs and an error budget for a customer-facing service, link them to SLAs and change policies, and run a postmortem for a simulated outage.
days.deliverable: SLO definitions, error budget policy and postmortem
checks: Changes paused when the budget is spent
Causes and actions recorded without blame

days.lab_task: Evaluate an AIOps approach on a month of event data: measure noise reduction from correlation, check anomaly detection against known incidents and design rules for automated remediation.
days.deliverable: Evaluation report and automation rules

days.topic: Organisational Change Management for Service Transformation
days.lab_task: Plan the people side of moving a service desk to a swarming model: stakeholder map, resistance plan, communication, training and adoption measures.
days.deliverable: Change management plan

days.lab_task: Build a skills matrix for a service team with SFIA, plan workforce needs for the next year, and design on-call practices that protect wellbeing.
days.deliverable: Skills matrix, workforce plan and on-call design
checks: Rota limits and recovery time included

days.topic: Service Experience and Experience Level Agreements
days.lab_task: Design an XLA for the laptop and collaboration services, measure baseline experience, act on the worst finding and report the change.
days.deliverable: XLA, baseline, actions and report
checks: Data from at least two sources

days.lab_task: Design service management for a cloud-hosted service covering responsibilities, incidents with the provider, change, cost showback and governance.
days.deliverable: Cloud service management design and cost report
checks: Costs shown by team and service

days.topic: ITSM Tool Strategy and Platform Selection
subtopics: ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, BMC and others
days.lab_task: Run a tool selection for a 3,000-user company: write requirements, score three platforms, run a proof of concept on two criteria and recommend one with cost.
days.deliverable: Requirements, scoring, PoC results and recommendation

days.lab_task: Run a technology radar exercise for the service organisation, evaluate one emerging technology with a pilot plan and decide whether to adopt, trial or hold.
days.deliverable: Technology radar, pilot plan and decision
checks: Each technology placed with a reason
Success criteria and exit rules defined

days.topic: Measuring Value and Reporting to Executives
days.lab_task: Build an executive scorecard linking IT services to business outcomes, benchmark against industry data and present a funding case to a mock executive team.
days.deliverable: Scorecard and executive presentation

days.lab_task: Lead a simulated multi-day outage with a regulator notification, executive briefings and customer updates, then run the post-crisis review.
days.deliverable: Command log, communications and post-crisis review
checks: Sent within the required time with correct content
Clear status, impact and decisions needed

days.lab_task: Assess a service organisation's maturity, design a target state and build a two-year transformation roadmap with funding, governance and measures.
days.deliverable: Maturity assessment, target state and roadmap

days.topic: ITIL Strategic Leader Exam Preparation: DITS and DPI
days.lab_task: Take timed practice exams for Digital and IT Strategy and Direct, Plan and Improve, review wrong answers and plan study.
days.deliverable: Practice scores, review notes and study plan
checks: Each linked to a syllabus area
objectives: Prepare for ITIL Strategic Leader modules

subtopics: Signs of a failing service organisation
tools: Jira Service Management or ServiceNow reports
days.lab_task: Diagnose a failing service organisation from tool data and interviews, build a 90-day recovery plan and present it to the CIO.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis, recovery plan and presentation
checks: Supported by ticket and change data
Quick wins and structural fixes with owners

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: IT Service Strategy and Transformation Plan
days.lab_task: Produce a service strategy and transformation plan for a large organisation with strategy, portfolio decisions, governance and SIAM model, high-velocity and SRE practices, AIOps, workforce and change plans and measures, then present it to a mock board.
days.deliverable: Strategy and transformation plan, scorecard and a 20-minute board presentation
checks: Each linked to value and cost
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one plan
Defend the plan to a board
